paragraphs.source_zh: “在下愚钝，大人见谅。既如此，忠胜肝脑涂地，在所不辞。这便立刻出发！”

paragraphs.source_en: Before the words had left his mouth, Ii Naomasa also rose. “I shall first convey your intent to the whole army.”

units.source_en: Before the words had left his mouth, Ii Naomasa also rose. “I shall first convey your intent to the whole army.”
units.source_zh: 话音未落，井伊直政也站了起来，“在下先把这个意思传达三军。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 话音未落，井伊直政也站了起来，“在下先把这个意思传达三军。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Good. Do not forget to tell Tōdō, Lord of Sado, as well. Tell everyone that I am unwell today, and that men and horses are therefore to rest for the day; on the thirteenth we shall enter Gifu, and on the fourteenth reach Akasaka.”

units.source_en: “Good.
Do not forget to tell Tōdō, Lord of Sado, as well.
units.source_zh: 别忘了也告诉藤堂佐渡守。

units.source_en: Tell everyone that I am unwell today, and that men and horses are therefore to rest for the day; on the thirteenth we shall enter Gifu, and on the fourteenth reach Akasaka.”
units.source_zh: 你通知众人，就说今日我抱恙，索性让人马歇息一日，十三日入驻岐阜，十四日抵赤坂。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “好。别忘了也告诉藤堂佐渡守。你通知众人，就说今日我抱恙，索性让人马歇息一日，十三日入驻岐阜，十四日抵赤坂。”

paragraphs.source_en: As planned, the following day they traveled from Kiyosu to Gifu. After reaching Gifu, Ieyasu took up residence in the mansion of Tsuzura Tsuneyoshi, a senior Oda retainer who had already surrendered. He then wrote to Niwa Nagashige and Hijikata Katsuhisa in Hokuriku, ordering Nagashige and Aoki Kazunori to negotiate peace with Maeda Toshinaga. Hijikata Katsuhisa had earlier been exiled to Ōta in Hitachi, but this time had gone as an envoy to the northern provinces under Ieyasu’s secret instructions.

units.source_en: As planned, the following day they traveled from Kiyosu to Gifu.
units.source_zh: 照计，第二日从清洲抵岐阜。

units.source_en: After reaching Gifu, Ieyasu took up residence in the mansion of Tsuzura Tsuneyoshi, a senior Oda retainer who had already surrendered.
units.source_zh: 到达岐阜之后，家康住入已归降的织田家老百百纲家府邸。

units.source_en: He then wrote to Niwa Nagashige and Hijikata Katsuhisa in Hokuriku, ordering Nagashige and Aoki Kazunori to negotiate peace with Maeda Toshinaga.
units.source_zh: 然后，他给北陆的丹羽长重和土方雄久写了书函，令长重、青木一矩二人与前田利长议和。

units.source_en: Hijikata Katsuhisa had earlier been exiled to Ōta in Hitachi, but this time had gone as an envoy to the northern provinces under Ieyasu’s secret instructions.
units.source_zh: 土方雄久曾在早些时候被流放到常陆的太田，这次在家康的秘密授意下出使北国。

paragraphs.source_zh: 照计，第二日从清洲抵岐阜。到达岐阜之后，家康住入已归降的织田家老百百纲家府邸。然后，他给北陆的丹羽长重和土方雄久写了书函，令长重、青木一矩二人与前田利长议和。土方雄久曾在早些时候被流放到常陆的太田，这次在家康的秘密授意下出使北国。

paragraphs.source_en: The next day, Ieyasu made a detour to avoid the crossing nearest Ōgaki Castle, crossed at Nagara, and reached Okayama, south of Akasaka Station. From there, Ōgaki Castle, a little more than fifty chō away, seemed almost within reach.

units.source_en: The next day, Ieyasu made a detour to avoid the crossing nearest Ōgaki Castle, crossed at Nagara, and reached Okayama, south of Akasaka Station.
units.source_zh: 第二日，家康绕路避开了离大垣城较近的渡口，越过长良渡，抵达赤坂驿南的冈山。

units.source_en: From there, Ōgaki Castle, a little more than fifty chō away, seemed almost within reach.
units.source_zh: 由此望去，五十余町外，大垣城近在眼前。

paragraphs.source_zh: 第二日，家康绕路避开了离大垣城较近的渡口，越过长良渡，抵达赤坂驿南的冈山。由此望去，五十余町外，大垣城近在眼前。

paragraphs.source_en: “Ukita Hideie, the Chūnagon; Konishi Yukinaga, Lord of Settsu; and Ishida Mitsunari, the Jibu-shōyū, are all inside Ōgaki Castle. Fukuhara Umanosuke is there as well.”

units.source_en: “Ukita Hideie, the Chūnagon; Konishi Yukinaga, Lord of Settsu; and Ishida Mitsunari, the Jibu-shōyū, are all inside Ōgaki Castle.
units.source_zh: “宇喜多中纳言秀家、小西摄津守行长、石田治部少辅都在大垣城中。

units.source_en: Fukuhara Umanosuke is there as well.”
units.source_zh: 福原右马助同在。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “宇喜多中纳言秀家、小西摄津守行长、石田治部少辅都在大垣城中。福原右马助同在。”

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu listened intently to Naomasa’s report, nodding repeatedly, then ordered his golden-fan battle standard, seven great banners bearing the family crest, and twenty smaller banners to be planted facing Ōgaki Castle.

units.source_en: Ieyasu listened intently to Naomasa’s report, nodding repeatedly, then ordered his golden-fan battle standard, seven great banners bearing the family crest, and twenty smaller banners to be planted facing Ōgaki Castle.
units.source_zh: 家康一边认真倾听直政的报告，一边频频点头，然后命人朝大垣城方向插上金扇马印和七面印有家纹的大旗，另有二十面小旗。

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康一边认真倾听直政的报告，一边频频点头，然后命人朝大垣城方向插上金扇马印和七面印有家纹的大旗，另有二十面小旗。

paragraphs.source_en: The arquebus corps, messengers, and others who had set out at midnight had arrived ahead of Ieyasu and were keeping strict watch around the encampment.

units.source_en: The arquebus corps, messengers, and others who had set out at midnight had arrived ahead of Ieyasu and were keeping strict watch around the encampment.
units.source_zh: 半夜就已出发的火枪营、传令使等，则比家康提前一步赶到这里，在阵营周围严加戒备。

paragraphs.source_zh: 半夜就已出发的火枪营、传令使等，则比家康提前一步赶到这里，在阵营周围严加戒备。

paragraphs.source_en: Just how great an effect did Ieyasu’s arrival have on the Western Army? The activity at Okayama must also have been visible from Ōgaki Castle. Needless to say, long before Ieyasu arrived, they had thoroughly investigated the disposition of the Eastern Army forces in the surrounding area.

units.source_en: Just how great an effect did Ieyasu’s arrival have on the Western Army?
units.source_zh: 家康的到来，究竟给西军带来了多大影响？

units.source_en: The activity at Okayama must also have been visible from Ōgaki Castle.
units.source_zh: 从大垣城那边应也可以望见冈山的动静。

units.source_en: Needless to say, long before Ieyasu arrived, they had thoroughly investigated the disposition of the Eastern Army forces in the surrounding area.
units.source_zh: 不消说，在家康到来之前，他们早就把周边东军的情况打探得一清二楚了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康的到来，究竟给西军带来了多大影响？从大垣城那边应也可以望见冈山的动静。不消说，在家康到来之前，他们早就把周边东军的情况打探得一清二楚了。

paragraphs.source_en: When departing from Osaka, Ishida Mitsunari had boasted, “Even if ten Ieyasus were to come, I would not fear them in the least!” There was, of course, an element of self-encouragement in those words, but neither were they mere empty bravado.

units.source_en: When departing from Osaka, Ishida Mitsunari had boasted, “Even if ten Ieyasus were to come, I would not fear them in the least!”
units.source_zh: 从大坂出发时，石田三成就曾放出豪言壮语：“即使来十个家康，我也毫不畏惧！”

units.source_en: There was, of course, an element of self-encouragement in those words, but neither were they mere empty bravado.

ja.t: もあったが、まったくの

units.source_zh: 内中当然含有鞭策自己的意思，但他也绝非完全在耍嘴皮子。

paragraphs.source_zh: 从大坂出发时，石田三成就曾放出豪言壮语：“即使来十个家康，我也毫不畏惧！”内中当然含有鞭策自己的意思，但他也绝非完全在耍嘴皮子。

paragraphs.source_en: Yet after advancing into Akasaka and the surrounding area, the Eastern Army suddenly halted.

units.source_en: Yet after advancing into Akasaka and the surrounding area, the Eastern Army suddenly halted.
units.source_zh: 进至赤坂及周边一带，东军竟停止了步伐。

paragraphs.source_zh: 进至赤坂及周边一带，东军竟停止了步伐。

paragraphs.source_en: “It must be a bluff.”

units.source_en: “It must be a bluff.”
units.source_zh: “那定是故弄玄虚。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “那定是故弄玄虚。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Now that you mention it, Kanamori Hōin’s white standard does seem rather similar to Ieyasu’s.”

units.source_en: “Now that you mention it, Kanamori Hōin’s white standard does seem rather similar to Ieyasu’s.”
units.source_zh: “如此说来，金森法印的白旗好像与家康的很相似啊。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “如此说来，金森法印的白旗好像与家康的很相似啊。”

paragraphs.source_en: “For now, send scouts to learn the truth.”

units.source_en: “For now, send scouts to learn the truth.”
units.source_zh: “且先派探马前去打听虚实。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “且先派探马前去打听虚实。”

paragraphs.source_en: The Eastern Army had plainly advanced as far as the Akasaka area, only to halt midway. The reason could not be simple. With the Western Army already disunited, the sensitive Mitsunari was thrown into doubt once more.

units.source_en: The Eastern Army had plainly advanced as far as the Akasaka area, only to halt midway.
units.source_zh: 东军明明已进发到赤坂一带，又中道而止。

units.source_en: The reason could not be simple.
units.source_zh: 原因绝不简单。

units.source_en: With the Western Army already disunited, the sensitive Mitsunari was thrown into doubt once more.
units.source_zh: 而西军军心涣散，又让敏感的三成犹疑起来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 东军明明已进发到赤坂一带，又中道而止。原因绝不简单。而西军军心涣散，又让敏感的三成犹疑起来。

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu’s arrival instantly threw the Western Army into complete confusion.

units.source_en: Ieyasu’s arrival instantly threw the Western Army into complete confusion.
units.source_zh: 家康的到来，登时令西军方寸大乱。
